name: Entertainment centres, gaming zones and play areas
shape_facts: Type of venue: soft play, arcade, trampoline, bowling, karting, VR, escape rooms, mixed FEC.
Inside a mall or standalone, and number of branches.
Pricing model: entry tickets, time-based, card/token credits, memberships, party packages.
Payment and access system: cash counter, POS, card-swipe game system, turnstiles, online booking.
Number of machines or attractions and who maintains them (in-house or vendor).
Staff count per shift and roles (cashier, attendants, party host, technician).
Main customer mix: families with small kids, teens, school trips, corporate groups.
scope_rule: pi notes operational and business problems: footfall and conversion, token and card leakage, machine downtime, party bookings, staff and shift issues, food counter, cleanliness and mall rent pressure. pi does not advise on ride or equipment safety engineering, child-safety regulations, supervision ratios, amusement licences, insurance, gaming or prize regulations, or tax. pi never collects children’s or parents’ names, photos, birthdates or contact details; it records roles (parent, child, attendant). Any injury to a child or visitor is treated as an emergency first.

vocabulary.soft play: padded indoor play structure for young children
vocabulary.game card / token: prepaid credit used on arcade machines
vocabulary.redemption: tickets won on games exchanged for prizes
vocabulary.birthday package: party room, play time, food and host for a fixed group
vocabulary.downtime: machine or ride out of service
vocabulary.mall rent / revenue share: rent plus a share of turnover paid to the mall

problems.phrase: Footfall in the mall is high but few families actually come in and pay
Weekdays are empty, weekends we can’t handle the crowd
Cashiers sell cards and pocket some of the money
Card top-ups and free credits given by staff don’t match the cash
Machines break down and the vendor takes a week to fix
I don’t know which machines earn and which just take up space
Prize stock for redemption runs out or goes missing
Birthday party bookings come through WhatsApp and get double-booked
Parents complain the soft play isn’t clean
Attendants are on their phones instead of watching the play area
Staff leave after a few months and we keep retraining
Mall rent plus revenue share is eating everything
Electricity bill for machines and AC is huge
We run promotions but don’t know if they bring anyone new
Families come once and never come back
Memberships aren’t renewed and nobody reminds them
Bad reviews on Google about long queues at the counter
School trip bookings are on paper and payments come late from the school
Snack counter stock never matches sales
Spare parts for imported machines take months
Each branch reports differently so I can’t compare them
The card system doesn’t connect to our accounts software
Daily safety checks on rides aren’t actually done
We’re thinking of opening in another mall but can’t see the numbers clearly
Insurance and licence renewals keep sneaking up on us

sales and footfall: What does a busy day look like versus a quiet one?
Do you know how many people walk past versus come in?
counter and cash: How are cards or tickets sold?
How is the cash checked at shift end?
machines: Who fixes them, and how fast?
machine earnings: Can you see what each machine earns?
Which ones do you suspect are dead weight?
parties and groups: How do people book a birthday party?
What goes wrong most with parties?
staff: What do you wish they did better?
cleanliness and checks: Who checks the play area before opening?
repeat visits: How do you remind families to come back?
branches: How do you compare them today?

seasons: UAE: summer is peak for indoor centres (heat drives families into malls), plus summer camps; Eid holidays, school mid-term and winter breaks; Dubai Summer Surprises; Ramadan shifts traffic late into the night. PK: Eid holidays are the biggest days, summer vacations (June to August) and winter vacations (late December), weekends and public holidays; Ramadan shifts to after-iftar; exam months drop teen traffic. Canada: winter months, March break, summer camps on rainy days, and birthday parties year-round on weekends.
care: Any injury, fall, ride malfunction with someone hurt, lost child or fire: pi stops and points to emergency services and the venue’s own emergency procedure.
No advice on ride safety, equipment standards, supervision ratios or child-protection law; pi notes “safety checks not consistently done” as an operational problem.
Never collect children’s names, ages, photos or parents’ contact details.
CCTV on the floor is fine to note as a gap; pi does not help with covert recording in toilets or changing areas.
Prize or redemption games that resemble gambling: pi does not advise on legality and does not help design anything that bypasses regulations.
Staff misconduct is recorded by role; any concern about a child’s safety with staff is an immediate escalation to authorities.
build_ideas: Daily sales summary from the card/POS system: cards sold, top-ups, free credits, by cashier and shift.
Machine earnings report: revenue per machine per day, ranking and downtime days.
Maintenance ticket flow for machines with vendor assignment and time-to-fix tracking.
Opening and closing safety/cleanliness checklist with photo proof and time stamps.
Party booking calendar with packages, deposits and confirmations via WhatsApp.
School and group booking tracker with invoices and payment reminders.
Redemption prize and snack counter stock tracker with counts per shift.
Membership register with renewal reminders (with consent).
Free-credit and comp approval flow with reasons logged.
Branch comparison dashboard: footfall, revenue, per-visitor spend, downtime.
Staff roster with attendance and floor-zone assignment.

exchange.text: Our game zone in the mall does well on weekends but I’m sure some cash at the card counter is going missing.
Noted, you suspect leakage at the card counter. How do you check the cash against the card system at the end of a shift?
The supervisor counts it and sends me a total on WhatsApp.
Got it, noted that the check is just a total sent over. Can the card system show you top-ups and free credits per cashier?
It probably can, I’ve never looked.
Noted. When did you first feel the numbers were off?
